summary.text: Joe Gresko, a Democrat, has represented District 121 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since February 3, 2016, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Stratford, Connecticut, and earned a bachelor's degree in environmental science from Central Connecticut State University.

He has worked as a weather forecaster at Western Connecticut State University, as a radio news reporter at WICC/WEBE, and in the City of Bridgeport administration managing media relations and public affairs.
